title: Normalized finite scalar mate maps
statement: theorem finiteScalarMaps_exists (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p) (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L] (n m : ℕ) (a : Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+* Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (m + 1)) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f) (scalarX : Scalar l E L n m a X) (scalarY : Scalar l E L n m a Y) (source : Operation l E n c) (target : Operation l L m c) : Nonempty (ConstructionMaps l E L n m a c scalarX scalarY source target)

proof.text: Compose the canonical proper coefficient comparison with the open balancing comparison, transport the resulting Hom transpose through the finite operation adjunctions, and record the normalized maps, shifts and etale mate package.
